question: Show the names of students who have a grade higher than 9 and have at least 2 friends.
gold_query: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.id WHERE T2.grade > 9 GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*) >= 2
